scope: rounds 49 to 67 of the pure batch-one decode work on one 8 x Ascend 910B3 (64 GiB a card) server
note: the parent follow-up bundle records an earlier state and is left untouched; this section records what happened afterwards and does not restate it

registered_result.parity: token_ids_equal_pair and token_ids_equal_canonical both true on all 8 ranks in every pair
registered_result.class: bit-exact device relocation of the sparse indexer selection (attention.py:1173)

straggler_wait_is_routing_imbalance.reading: the busiest expert-parallel owner does about seven times the least busy one, which is the 19.3% of the step spent at collective barriers with every core idle

streams_do_not_overlap.compute_against_compute: two 4096^3 bf16 matmuls on two streams 1078.4 us against 1043.3 us sequential
streams_do_not_overlap.compute_against_collective: matmul against a 20 KB allReduce on two streams 481.5 us against 380.3 us sequential, i.e. the no-overlap sum (479.5) not the overlapped maximum (301.7)
streams_do_not_overlap.reading: the barrier wait cannot be hidden under work on another stream on this device

device_is_wall_to_wall_busy.reading: host-side time is overlapped, so host restructuring has no headroom; every remaining gain must be less or faster device work

closed_negative_results.why: improves a small collective's own latency; the wait here is for compute that has not arrived, so it cannot help. Attempted twice and never successfully measured, which is recorded rather than hidden.
which owner holds which expert is the model's own routing and part of the protected contract
measured unavailable on this device, both cases
decode_pos.py:194 shows Pos.host is a plain Python int property, no synchronisation
95 calls and 4277.7 us of host time a forward, but the device is 91.3% busy so it is overlapped

closed_negative_results.item: rank-based sort for the 2048-wide candidate block selection
closed_negative_results.why: measured 0.66x, i.e. slower than the four operators it would remove, so it was left alone

deployment_survey.same_hardware_deliverable: CJYLZS/vllm-ascend-deepseek-v41-a2, 8 x 910B3 at 65536 MB a card
deployment_survey.implication: at an acceptance length of one, that tuned stack is about 36.9 tok/s, so 50 tok/s pure batch-one is outside what the hardware gives even with a reference-quality stack; 50+ requires the model emitting more than one token a step
